parameters.name: Args
parameters.description:
The input parameters of the service to invoke. The data is in JSON string format, such as **Args={"param1":1}**.
If this parameter is empty, pass **Args={}**.

><notice>If the data type defined in the TSL model is float or double, the corresponding parameter value (even if it is an integer) must contain at least one decimal place. For example, 10.0 or 11.1.
></notice>

parameters.name: DeviceName
parameters.description:
The DeviceName of the device on which you want to invoke the service.
><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **ProductKey**.
></notice>

parameters.name: Identifier
parameters.description:
The identifier of the service.

To view the **Identifier** of a device service:

- Log on to the [IoT Platform console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/) and view the identifier in the **Define Feature** section of the product to which the device belongs.
- Call the [QueryThingModel](~~150321~~) operation and view the identifier in the returned TSL model information.

> If the service **testService** belongs to a custom (non-default) module **testFb**, set this parameter to **testFb:testService**.

parameters.name: IotId
parameters.description:
The ID of the device on which you want to invoke the service. This is the unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for the device.
><notice> **IotId** is the unique identifier of a device and corresponds one-to-one with the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** or **DeviceName**. If you specify **IotId** together with **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, **IotId** takes precedence.
></notice>

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. On the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console, view the **ID** of the current instance.

><notice>
- If the **ID** value is displayed, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the **Overview** page or **ID** value is not displayed, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description:
The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs.
><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.
></notice>
